name: Goa Scooter/Bike Rental
description: Widely available scooter and bike rentals, the most common way tourists get around Goa.

name: GTDC Local Bus Service
description: State-run bus network connecting most towns and beach areas, inexpensive but less frequent.

name: Goa Miles App Taxi
description: Local app-based taxi service, a reliable option for late-night or longer point-to-point trips.

name: River Ferry, Old Goa
description: Small ferry crossings across the Mandovi, a scenic and cheap way to cross between river banks.
